monster.name: Aboleth

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mucous Cloud
trait.text: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be diseased.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The aboleth makes three tentacle attacks.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become diseased.

action.name: Tail
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Enslave (3/Day)
action.text: The aboleth targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: The aboleth can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn.

legendary.name: Detect
legendary.text: The aboleth makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary.name: Tail Swipe
legendary.text: The aboleth makes one tail attack.

legendary.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the aboleth regains hit points equal to the damage the creature takes.

legendary.name: Aboleth Lairs
legendary.text: On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the aboleth can take a lair action to cause one of the following effects.

legendary.name: Phantasmal Image
legendary.text: The aboleth creates an illusory duplicate of itself until initiative count 20 on the next round.

monster.description:
Aboleths are ancient amphibious tyrants that lurk in deep water and dominate weaker minds.
Source: System Reference Document 5.1 p. 261
monster.homebrewNote: Kept as-is: unknown element for the extra test.

monster.name: Aboleth [5.5e]

trait.name: Amphibious
trait.text: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

action.name: Tentacle
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be diseased.

action.name: Consume Memories
action.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the aboleth gains the target's memories. Success: Half damage.

action.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)
action.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence.

legendary.name: Legendary Actions (3/Turn)
legendary.text: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

legendary.name: Lash
legendary.text: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Psychic Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary.text: If the aboleth has at least one creature Charmed by it, the aboleth uses Consume Memories and regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

legendary.name: Aboleth Lairs
legendary.text: The aboleth's lair grants it Regional Effects while it is alive.

monster.description:
An aboleth is an amphibious tyrant. Its lair is a place of dread.
Source: System Reference Document 5.2.1, p. 340

monster.name: Goblin Warrior [5.5e]

action.name: Scimitar
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

action.name: Shortbow
action.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

action.name: Nimble Escape (Bonus Action)
action.text: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

monster.description:
Goblin warriors scout and raid in bands.
Source: System Reference Document 5.2.1 p. 380

monster.name: Young Red Dragon

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The dragon makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

action.name: Claw
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

action.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
action.text: The dragon exhales fire in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 56 (16d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monster.description:
Young red dragons are vain, greedy and quick to anger.
Source: System Reference Document 5.1 p. 274

monster.name: Mage
monster.spells: Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield, Misty Step, Suggestion, Counterspell, Fireball, Fly, Greater Invisibility, Ice Storm, Cone of Cold

trait.name: Spellcasting
trait.text: The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks).

action.name: Dagger
action.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Shield Spell
reaction.text: When the mage is hit by an attack, it can cast shield as a reaction, gaining +5 AC until the start of its next turn.

monster.description:
Mages spend their lives in the study of arcane lore.
Source: System Reference Document 5.1 p. 402

monster.name: Awakened Shrub
monster.languages: one language known by its creator

trait.name: False Appearance
trait.text: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

action.name: Rake
action.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 - 1) slashing damage.

spell.name: Fireball
spell.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spell.text: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Fireball [5.5e]
spell.components: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spell.text: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Potion of Healing
item.text: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

item.name: Ring of Protection
item.text: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

item.name: Chain Mail
item.text: Heavy armor made of interlocking metal rings.

feat.name: Alert
feat.text: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain a +5 bonus to initiative and cannot be surprised while conscious.

trait.name: Description
trait.text: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal.

trait.name: Darkvision
trait.text: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light.

trait.name: Dwarven Resilience
trait.text: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

trait.name: Description
trait.text: You have spent your life in the service of a temple.

trait.name: Shelter of the Faithful
trait.text: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at a temple of your faith.

class.name: Wizard
class.proficiency: Intelligence, Wisdom, Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, Religion
class.weapons: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.text: As a student of arcane magic, you have a spellbook containing spells.

feature.name: Arcane Recovery
feature.text: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots.

feature.name: School of Evocation: Evocation Savant
feature.text: The gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.
